meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 主机上运行后,它为指定 agent 的容器装上 dial 命令和配套技能,并经 OneCLI 按 agent 注入 api.getdial.ai 凭据,使其能在沙盒里发短信、打 AI 语音电话、收验证码。未选中的 agent 会被网关拦截。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 从聊天里发短信、打电话或运行 dial 命令,而不把 Dial 接成消息渠道时触发。需从主机运行,且要求已配置 OneCLI。

say.text: 给 ag-001 装上 Dial 工具
say.note: ag-001 将能在容器里发短信和打电话

say.text: 运行 /add-dial-tool,把所有 agent 都加上 Dial
say.note: 全部 agent 获得 Dial 权限

say.text: 用 /add-dial-tool 把 Dial 只给 ag-001,其他都挡住

howto.what_en: Run on the NanoClaw host, it installs the dial CLI and its skill into chosen agents' containers and injects an api.getdial.ai credential per agent via OneCLI, so they can text, place AI voice calls, and receive codes. Unchosen agents are blocked at the gateway.
howto.when_en: Use when you want agents to text, call, or run dial commands from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel. Run from the host; OneCLI required.

say_en.text: Add the Dial tool to ag-001
say_en.note: ag-001 can then text and call from its container

say_en.text: Run /add-dial-tool and give Dial to all agents
Give Dial only to ag-001 and block the rest
say_en.note: re-run to change who is allowed
